model.organicThreshold: Minimum organic share for lifetime payback

notes.ltv: Contribution LTV = net subscription revenue minus AI and variable infrastructure costs, weighted across monthly and annual plans.
notes.cac: Paid CAC = cost per install ÷ install-to-paid conversion. Blended CAC assumes the same conversion for organic installs and zero incremental organic spend.
notes.payback: Payback is the first month cumulative contribution covers blended CAC. The model recognizes annual revenue over each 12-month term and includes one possible renewal.
notes.fixed: Operating break-even = fixed costs ÷ monthly contribution per active subscriber, rounded up. Acquisition spend is tracked separately in CAC.
notes.limits: The model excludes free-tier usage, voice, taxes, refunds and wearable integration costs. AI infrastructure uses the planned token volumes from the report and Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Standard text rates.
notes.source: Prices, conversion, paid acquisition and renewal assumptions come from section 4 of the Fitness Companion Market Evidence & Unit Economics Report.
notes.pilot: The pilot uses a 90% organic target and a $50 monthly budget assumption. Include ongoing labor, content and other recurring costs in your actual budget.

model.pilotPlan: Launch target: {organic} organic acquisition and a {budget} monthly operating budget.

activity.title: Product activity
activity.subtitle: Recorded app events on this browser and device.
activity.emptyDetail: Finish onboarding, start a workout or use the coach to populate this view.
activity.unavailableDetail: Allow site storage to record and view activity here.

notes.retention: Counts start when this dashboard’s event storage is enabled. The browser retains up to 4,000 recent events and shows up to 90 calendar days.
notes.workouts: Logged workouts include partial sessions. The 80% metric uses the planned set count after workout adjustments and excludes extra sessions, safety stops and seeded history.
notes.subscription: Trials in the app are simulated. Prices, acquisition costs and AI expenses above are planning estimates.
notes.cohorts: The product goal is three planned workouts in the first 14 days. Cohort activation and retention require shared user IDs and server-side event collection.

activity.demoSubtitle: Sample events for a simulated product launch.

cohorts.title: Cohorts
cohorts.detail: Grouped by onboarding week. A dash marks an observation window that’s still open.
cohorts.comparable: Same {users} users across all four days, from cohorts with a full 30-day window.
cohorts.definitions: Retention counts users who started a workout on the exact day after onboarding. Activation is three planned workouts with at least 80% of sets completed in the first 14 days. Paid D35 counts the first simulated payment by the end of day 35.
cohorts.emptyDetail: Multi-user cohorts need shared user IDs and billing events. Explore the view with a simulated dataset.
